senses.gloss: (b. h., cmp. preced.) to tie, connect, to covenant (Assyr. ḫatânu, to protect. Friedr. Del. Proleg. p. 91).
to become connected, to enter into the family, to intermarry.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 82a:4">Snh. 82ᵃ</cite> <he>כאלו מִתְחַתֵּן בע״א</he> as if he connected himself with idols.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 82">Gen. R. s. 82</cite>, beg. <he>שנ׳ ביהודית וכ׳</he> who married Judith &c.
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 52">Sifré Deut. 52</cite>, a. e. <he>שנ׳ … עם וכ׳</he> when Solomon married the daughter of Pharaoh; a. fr.
